title: 第七章 被遗忘的天才第八章 闯祸
content_zh:
大殿非常的广阔，里面的面积更是无比巨大，此刻，大殿内已经零零散散的坐着十几个人，都是一些打扮各异的中年男子。
碧云天带着剑尘径直走到一张靠近主位的座椅前座了下来，而要想在这里拥有座位，那必须有一定的身份地位才行，而剑尘虽然是长阳府的四公子，但现在在这里还没有他的位置，所以，剑尘和他的母亲碧云天坐在同一张座椅上。
剑尘十分乖巧的坐在母亲碧云天身边，静静的等待着，也不说话。
很快，大殿内陆陆续续不断的有人走进来，然后找到各自的位置安静的做了下来，其中就连剑尘的三位姑姑也带着自己的孩子走了进来。
“嘿….四弟，今天可是你进行圣力测试的日子，你也一样要争气啊，不要让二姐失望哦。”长阳明月一张可爱的笑脸上充满了笑意，对着剑尘用非常轻的语气说道。虽然声音非常轻，但在这安静的大殿内，却让所有人都听的一清二楚。
“明月！”长阳明月的母亲皱着眉头看着她，语气带着一点责怪的轻喝道。
长阳明月轻轻一笑，冲着剑尘可爱的吐了吐舌头，没有继续在说话了，安安静静的坐在自己母亲身边，一双明亮的大眼睛扑闪扑闪的，不断的打量着大殿内的人。
很快，大殿内的人就坐满了，殿堂内所有人的目光都不时的在剑尘身上扫过，眼神中，都带着一丝期待的神色，这次他们聚集在一起，全部都是因为今日是剑尘满三岁进行圣力测试的日子。
若是普通的嫡系弟子，在进行圣力测试的时候根本就不会高的如此兴师动众，但剑尘毕竟身份不同，乃是长阳府家主的孩子，而且再加上他人从小就天赋绝顶，几乎让长阳府上下所有人都抱着非常高的期望之心，所以，剑尘进行圣力测试的时候，自然让这些在长阳府中有些身份的人员都非常的关注。
毕竟，剑尘在将来到底有多大的成就，今日的圣力测试将是一个非常重要的起步。
当众人都来齐之后，剑尘的父亲长阳霸才来到了大殿中，走上了代表家主之位的宝座前，大马金刀的坐在上面。
长阳霸目光在剑尘身上微微停留了会，脸上挂着一丝淡淡的微笑，随即环视一周，在说了一番场面话之后，剑尘的圣力测试很快就开始了。
“德叔，麻烦你替犬子进行圣力测试的仪式了。”长阳霸语气颇为客气的对着坐在下首的一名老者说道。
这名老者年纪看起来已经六七十岁了，身穿灰色衣衫，满头的白发，脸上已经布满了皱纹，不过那一双眼睛却炯炯有神。
老者微微一笑，道：“家主客气了。”说着，老者起身便走到大殿的中央，面带微笑的看向剑尘，语气和蔼的说道：“四少爷，请！”
碧云天满脸慈爱的看着坐在自己身边的剑尘，声音轻柔的道：“翔儿，乖，去德叔那里，让德叔测试一下你体内的圣力。”
“嗯！”剑尘轻轻的嗯了声，非常乖巧离开了座位，踏着小巧的步伐来到那名被称作德叔的老者身前。
德叔也不废话，缓缓的抬起来右手，接着，只见德叔戴在右手上的一枚银白色的戒指突然亮起了蒙蒙白光，随即，德叔右手轻轻一挥，只听得一声轻微的震动声从地面上传来，紧接着，原本空无一物的地面上，却毫无征兆的出现了一块半米高的白石，白石明显经过打磨过的，呈长方形状态，高半米，厚度和宽度都在一尺左右。
看着这突然出现了白石，剑尘眨了眨眼睛，对于这突然出现了白石，似乎感到非常奇怪，接着，剑尘的目光便移到德叔的右手上，直直的盯着那枚被德叔戴在中指上的银白色戒指。而脑中则迅速的浮现出一条在书中看到的信息。
空间戒指，由非常特殊而罕见的材料制造而成，戒指内自成空间，空间有大有小，最小的只有一米立方，大的甚至可以达到百米的立方，里面可以随意的存放任何没有生命的物体，乃是天元大陆上价格非常高昂的物品，普通人根本就不可能拥有。

发觉了剑尘那看向戴在自己手上的那枚空间戒指的目光，德叔微微一笑，几乎每一名见到他从空间戒指里拿出这枚测试圣之力的圣石，都会偷来这样的目光，对于这样的目光，德叔已经不知道见过多少次了。
“四少爷，请把一只手放在这圣石上。”德叔微笑的说道。
圣石，是一块能测试每一个人体内的圣力强度以及属性的特殊石头，在天元大陆上流传非常的广，乃是测试个人实力的唯一道具，圣石测试的结果由光芒的颜色来代替，分别为红色，橙色，黄色，绿色，青色，蓝色，紫色。
content_en:
The main hall is very vast, and the area inside is even more huge. At this moment, there are more than a dozen people sitting scattered in the main hall, all of them middle-aged men dressed in different styles.
Bi Yuntian took Jian Chen straight to a seat near the main seat and sat down. To have a seat here, one must have a certain status. Although Jian Chen is the fourth son of Changyang Mansion, there is no place for him here yet. Therefore, Jian Chen and his mother Bi Yuntian sat on the same seat.
Jian Chen sat obediently next to his mother Bi Yuntian, waiting quietly without speaking.
Soon, people came in one after another from the inside of the hall, and then found their respective seats and worked quietly. Among them, even Jian Chen's three aunts also walked in with their children.
"Hey...Fourth brother, today is the day for your holy power test. You also have to strive for success. Don't let the second sister down." Changyang Mingyue's cute smiling face was full of smiles, and she said to Jian Chen in a very light tone. Although the voice was very soft, everyone in the quiet hall could hear it clearly.
"Mingyue!" Changyang Mingyue's mother frowned at her and shouted lightly with a bit of reproach in her tone.
Changyang Mingyue smiled softly, stuck out her tongue cutely at Jian Chen, and stopped talking. She sat quietly next to her mother, her big bright eyes flickering, constantly looking at the people in the hall.
Soon, the people in the hall were full. Everyone in the hall glanced at Jian Chen from time to time, with a look of expectation in their eyes. This time they gathered together because today was the day when Jian Chen turned three years old and took the holy power test.
If he were an ordinary direct disciple, he wouldn't be so high-spirited in the Holy Power test. However, after all, Jian Chen has a different status. He is the child of the head of the Changyang Mansion. In addition, he has been extremely talented since he was a child. Almost everyone in the Changyang Mansion has very high expectations. Therefore, when Jian Chen conducts the Holy Power test, these people with some status in the Changyang Mansion are naturally very concerned.
After all, how much achievements Jian Chen will have in the future, today's holy power test will be a very important start.
When everyone came together, Jian Chen's father Changyang Bacai came to the main hall and walked up to the throne that represented the head of the family. The big horse with a golden sword sat on it.
Changyang Ba's eyes lingered on Jian Chen for a while, with a faint smile on his face, and then he looked around. After some words, Jian Chen's test of holy power soon began.
"Uncle De, please carry out the holy power test ceremony for Quanzi." Changyang Ba said in a rather polite tone to an old man sitting at the bottom.
This old man looked to be sixty or seventy years old. He was wearing gray clothes and had white hair. His face was already covered with wrinkles, but his eyes were bright.
The old man smiled slightly and said, "Master, you're welcome." After saying that, the old man stood up and walked to the center of the hall, looked at Jian Chen with a smile, and said in a kind tone: "Fourth Young Master, please!"
Biyuntian looked at Jian Chen who was sitting next to him with a loving face, and said in a soft voice: "Xiang'er, be good, go to Uncle De's place and let Uncle De test the holy power in your body."
"Yeah!" Jian Chen hummed softly, left his seat very obediently, and walked in front of the old man called Uncle De with small steps.
Uncle De did not waste any time and slowly raised his right hand. Then, a silver-white ring that Uncle De wore on his right hand suddenly lit up with a white light. Immediately, Uncle De waved his right hand lightly, and only heard a slight vibration coming from the ground. Then, on the originally empty ground, a half-meter-high white stone appeared without any warning. The white stone was clear.It appears to have been polished and is in a rectangular shape, half a meter high and about a foot thick and wide.
Seeing the sudden appearance of Bai Shi, Jian Chen blinked his eyes. He seemed to feel very strange about the sudden appearance of Bai Shi. Then, Jian Chen's eyes moved to Uncle De's right hand, staring straight at the silver-white ring worn by Uncle De on his middle finger. And a piece of information I saw in the book quickly appeared in my mind.
The space ring is made of very special and rare materials. The ring has its own space. The space can be large or small. The smallest one is only one meter cube, and the large one can even reach a hundred meter cube. Any inanimate objects can be stored in it at will. It is a very expensive item on Tianyuan Continent, and it is impossible for ordinary people to own it.
Realizing that Jian Chen was looking at the space ring on his hand, Uncle De smiled slightly. Almost everyone who saw him taking out this holy stone to test the power of the Saint would steal such a look. Uncle De had seen such a look countless times.
"Fourth Young Master, please put one hand on this holy stone." Uncle De said with a smile.
The Holy Stone is a special stone that can test the strength and attributes of the Holy Power in each person's body. It is widely circulated in Tianyuan Continent and is the only prop to test personal strength. The results of the Holy Stone test are replaced by the color of the light, which are red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, and purple.
